paras: The white-bellied honeyeater (Gliciphila notabilis), also known as the New Hebrides honeyeater and the Vanuatu honeyeater, is a species of bird in the family Meliphagidae.  It is endemic to the Melanesian island nation of Vanuatu. This species was formerly placed in the genus Glycifohia.
G. n. notabilis Sharpe, RB, 1899 – northwestern Vanuatu, including Banks Islands
G. n. superciliaris (Mayr, E, 1932) – Espiritu Santo to Epi (northern Vanuatu)
